summary: Fixes the post-release aggregate-drop dominance failure and restores compile performance on large programs.

highlights.title: Aggregate drop GEPs dominate nested arms
highlights.text: An aggregate binding with a Vec field created inside a conditional arm emitted its drop-time field GEP in a block reachable without the arm's alloca, so clang rejected the IR (the epos package). The field and Vec-data GEPs are registered in the entry block and the current data pointer is still loaded at drop time, so growth/realloc reclamation is preserved.

highlights.title: Large-program compile performance
highlights.text: The per-function ownership prepass rebuilt and cloned program-global catalogs for every function. With the engine's twelve thousand injected declarations this was quadratic and a full editor build never finished. Those sets are now built once per compile and shared, and the editor emits its IR and links in minutes.

highlights.title: One socket-handle ABI on every target
highlights.text: xiom_socket_create, xiom_socket_accept and xiom_socket_close return int64_t on every target, widening the POSIX int fd and the Win64 SOCKET. The stdlib declarations stay to Int. On arm64 the previous i32 definitions failed LLVM IR verification (@xiom_socket_close defined with type 'i32 (i64)*' but expected 'i64 (i64)*'), so every consumer of xiom.net.socket could not build. Probe p_socket_ffi_width (REL-20261030-1628-pulse).

highlights.title: POSIX SIGPIPE no longer kills the server
highlights.text: xiom_socket_send passes MSG_NOSIGNAL where available, and the runtime ignores SIGPIPE at init as a belt-and-braces guard (macOS has no MSG_NOSIGNAL). A client that connects, closes, and then receives a server write no longer terminates the process with exit 141. Windows is unchanged. Probe p_socket_sigpipe (REL-20261030-1645-xvector).

known_issues: Map/JSON/enum-tree retention (REL-1704) is the next memory slice.
Vec[Str] element strings and removal containers are not yet reclaimed.
By-value aggregate parameters are caller-transferred for retaining callees; callee-side parameter drops remain future work.
A cold full editor build is still a long compile (dependency C/C++ included); it now completes instead of stalling.
